items.docs: This endpoint returns information about the indestructibility configuration.
This endpoint returns details of an indestructibility configuration.
This endpoint can change the indestructibility password and/or the indestructibility password restore delay. The indestructibility mechanism must be unlocked before This endpoint can be done.
This endpoint generates an indestructibility token that is valid for one hour.

This endpoint restores the indestructibility password to its default value. This is indented for the case of a forgotten indestructibility password, where restoring to default enables a user to change the password again to a new secure password. There is a configurable delay until the password restore takes effect. The delay provides additional security in case of a rogue admin using VMS to restore the password.
